full_prompt_en: A square luminous fantasy painting shows sea turtles swimming through clear blue water in a mountain inlet at sunset. At the top center, a gap between high rocky walls opens onto a low gold sun. Violet and lavender clouds cover the sky, their broken edges catching peach light. Strong but soft-edged beams descend from that opening through the hazy middle distance and reach the water. Tall dark conifers and rounded rock ledges line the left bank. A steep blue-gray cliff rises along the right edge, with smaller trees standing on the near shore. The inlet occupies the lower half of the picture, its surface shifting from deep navy in the distance to vivid turquoise near the foreground. Horizontal glints of warm gold and pale blue mark gentle ripples; darker submerged shapes remain visible beneath the clear surface. One large turtle crosses the lower middle from left to right, its patterned dark shell raised above the glowing water and a long flipper angled beneath it. A smaller turtle glides farther back to the right, creating a second, quieter focal point. The unusual meeting of marine animals and mountain water feels dreamlike, but their bodies retain clear, natural contours and reflective wet surfaces. Short textured marks articulate rock, tree, shell, and ripples; broader smooth gradients carry the atmospheric depth. Light radiates from the sunset and reflects along a loose central path, placing the turtles against a cooler surrounding field. Indigo, violet, cyan, and gold remain saturated but carefully separated. The overall composition leads from bright foreground water through the narrow valley to the distant sun, balancing serene scale with an otherworldly encounter.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、发光的奇幻绘画描绘海龟在夕阳下的山间水湾里游过清澈蓝水。上方中央，高耸岩壁间的缺口露出低悬的金色太阳。紫色与淡紫云层铺满天空，断裂的云缘接住桃色光。强烈却边缘柔和的光束从缺口向下穿过朦胧中景，落到水面。高大暗色针叶树与圆润岩石平台排列在左岸。陡峭蓝灰色悬崖沿右缘升起，近岸另有较小树木。水湾占据画面下半，水色从远处深海军蓝转向前景鲜亮的青绿。暖金和浅蓝水平亮点标出轻柔涟漪；清澈表面下仍能看见较暗的水下形状。一只大海龟从左向右穿过下方中央，带花纹的深色龟壳隆起于发亮水面，一只长鳍向下倾斜。另一只较小海龟在更远的右侧滑行，成为第二处更安静的焦点。海洋动物与山水不同寻常的相遇带着梦境感，但身体保持清楚自然的轮廓与湿润反光。短小的纹理笔迹刻画岩石、树木、龟壳和涟漪，宽缓平滑的渐层承载空气纵深。光从夕阳向外散开，并沿松散的中央路径反射，让海龟衬在较冷的周围色域中。靛蓝、紫、青蓝与金色饱和却分区谨慎。整体构图从明亮的前景水域经过狭窄山谷通向远处太阳，以宁静尺度平衡超现实的相遇。
style_prompt_en: The luminous fantasy painting builds depth from saturated cool layers interrupted by a concentrated warm glow. Indigo and violet hold broad shadow masses, turquoise brightens nearer transparent passages, and peach-gold highlights mark openings and reflective bands. Smooth atmospheric gradients recede toward a distant light source, while short tactile strokes define nearer rough and wet surfaces. Dark side masses act as a frame around a luminous middle route, making the eye travel inward through several clearly separated planes. Beams and glints share the same warm direction, preserving a coherent light structure across very different textures. Edges are crisp around focal shapes but soften into haze and color vibration farther away. The overall effect is tranquil and fantastical, with intense color, glossy reflections, and strong depth held in balance.
style_prompt_zh: 这种发光的奇幻绘画以饱和冷色层次建立纵深，再由集中的暖光打断。靛蓝和紫色支撑宽阔暗部，青绿色点亮较近的透明区域，桃金色高光标出开口与反射带。平滑空气渐层向远处光源退去，短促而有触感的笔迹界定近处粗糙与湿亮表面。两侧深色大形体围住明亮的中部通路，让视线沿几层清楚分开的平面向内移动。光束和亮点遵循同一暖光方向，使相异肌理共享连贯的光照结构。焦点形状周围边缘清晰，远处则柔化为雾气与色彩振动。整体效果宁静而奇幻，让浓烈颜色、光亮反射和强烈纵深保持平衡。
theme_en: Sea turtles swim through a luminous mountain inlet at sunset
theme_zh: 海龟游过夕阳下发亮的山间水湾
name: Christian Riese Lassen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
